newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-IDEXX upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-IDEXX upgraded to buy.

text.p: --Vector Securities International Inc on Friday said it upgraded its rating on IDEXX Laboratories Inc shares to buy from attractive.
--The firm set a one-year price target of $19 based on a 25 multiple of its 1998 earnings estimate of $0.75 a share.

--Earlier Friday, IDEXX, which makes biotechnology-based detection systems used mainly in animal health, reported first-quarter earnings of $0.02 per share, falling short of Wall Street's already reduced estimate of $0.03 and Vector's $0.04.
--"We believe the primary problems encountered in the first quarter were inventory overload and a slowing of the overall growth of the vet business," said analyst Peter Drake in a report.
